body:
We'll need to update references for 53.2.3 due to updates on this topic. 

The blog post is now at: https://www.enablesecurity.com/blog/novel-dos-vulnerability-affecting-webrtc-media-servers/. We should also reference the associated [paper](https://www.enablesecurity.com/blog/webrtc-hello-race-conditions-paper/) which has further technical details.

I think it also makes sense to reference the DTLS-SRTP [protection profiles](https://www.iana.org/assignments/srtp-protection/srtp-protection.xhtml), due to #2547.
